description: This file defines the interface for the dmProviderDatabase class, which manages provider information including creation of queries and fetching provider details by various identifiers. It declares methods for loading provider data from a directory, creating query objects, and retrieving provider info objects.

classes.name: dmProviderDatabase
classes.description: A class responsible for managing provider information, creating queries, and retrieving provider details from a specified directory.

methods.name: dmProviderDatabase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider database with a directory path.

methods.name: createQuery
methods.description: Creates a new dmQuery object with a specified operation and string parameter.

methods.name: getProviderByProviderName
methods.description: Retrieves a provider info object by its provider name.

methods.name: getProviderByModelName
methods.description: Retrieves a provider info object by its model name.

methods.name: getProviderByPropertyName
methods.description: Retrieves a provider info object by property name, optionally indicating if it's a list item.

methods.name: getProviderByObjectName
methods.description: Retrieves a provider info object by object name, optionally indicating if it's a list item.

methods.name: loadFromDir
methods.description: Loads provider data from the specified directory.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads provider data from a specific file within a directory.

methods.name: makeProviderInfo
methods.description: Creates a provider info object from JSON data.

methods.name: buildProviderTree
methods.description: Builds the internal provider hierarchy or tree structure.
